decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal, because of its size, design and appearance, is considered acceptable having due regard to the site characteristics and would not harm the appearance of the house or the area as a whole, neighbours' living conditions or the parking provision for the street.  The proposed development therefore complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycling Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; Supplementary Planning Guidance (February 1997); and Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western and eastern flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE: A Tree Preservation Order protects all trees on this property.  Should you wish to do work on a tree/s an application must be submitted to and approved by the Council before any work is commenced.
description: Erection of part two storey part single-storey rear extension and conservatory to side and rear of existing house
